blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is scheduled to have bilateral meetings with United States President Donald Trump and United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres. Marcos is also set to meet the leaders of six more countries. These events will take place on the sidelines of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. Asean spokesperson Dominic Xavier Imperial said on Friday that leaders from Japan, Australia, Brazil, South Korea, India and Laos also expected to see Marcos between Nov. 15 to 17.
